items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the story 'The Necklace', and answer.

"Economists warn that many families fall into debt not because of emergencies but because of the wish to keep up appearances – a grand wedding, an expensive phone, a holiday to impress the neighbours. Loans are easy to take and slow to repay, and interest quietly multiplies what is owed."

Answer the following:
(i) Why do many families fall into debt, according to economists?
(ii) What does "interest quietly multiplies what is owed" mean?
(iii) How does this passage connect with the Loisels?
(iv) Which word means "to pay back"?  (a) multiply  (b) repay  (c) owe  (d) impress
items.answer: (i) Because of the wish to keep up appearances. (ii) Interest makes the debt grow larger and larger over time. (iii) Matilda's wish to look rich led to huge loans that took ten years to repay. (iv) (b) repay
items.markingKey: (i) Because of the wish to keep up appearances. (ii) Interest makes the debt grow larger and larger over time. (iii) Matilda's wish to look rich led to huge loans that took ten years to repay. (iv) (b) repay (1 mark each, 4 marks.)
